newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Steel Chemical cuts 6-mth earnings forecast.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Steel Chemical cuts 6-mth earnings forecast.

text.p: Nippon Steel Chemical Co Ltd said on Friday it had lowered its earnings forecast for the half year to September 30, due to the cost of dissolving unprofitable subsidiaries.
The company expects to incur a 16.2 billion yen loss from dissolving unprofitable subsidiaries in the interim period, it said in a statement.
It also said it would not stockholdings to offset the loss, as it had originally planned.
The company now expects a net parent loss of 16.2 billion yen in the half year period, compared with the previous forecast of zero net profits.

However, the sales forecast for the April-September period was revised upward to 131 billion yen from 128 billion yen. Its parent current profit forecast was unchanged from the previous forecast of 200 million yen.
